steps.say: Myositis is symmetric proximal weakness with raised muscle enzymes and irritable EMG. Hips and shoulders fail while wrists and ankles hold. CK, aldolase, and transaminases all rise together. Weakness with rash or lung disease requires antibody panels.
steps.tx: Idiopathic inflammatory **myopathies** (autoimmune muscle diseases) cause symmetric proximal weakness with raised creatine kinase (**CK**, muscle injury enzyme), aldolase, and transaminases plus electromyographic irritability (fibrillations with early recruitment). Hip and shoulder girdles fail while distal strength holds. Proximal weakness with raised CK indicates inflammatory myopathy, and the rash, antibodies, and biopsy below name it.

vis.alt: Proximal muscle weakness with interstitial lung disease and endomysial inflammatory infiltrate.
vis.caption: Proximal weakness with lung disease and endomysial infiltrates defines the polymyositis end. Antibodies and rashes split the rest. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Gottron papules over knuckles with heliotrope eyelids are the definers of dermatomyositis. Shawl and V-neck rashes extend the signature further. Biopsy is perifascicular atrophy at fiber edges. Rash with weakness is dermatomyositis until proven otherwise.
steps.tx: Dermatomyositis pairs weakness with pathognomonic rashes: **Gottron papules** (violaceous knuckle papules over MCP and PIP joints) with Gottron sign, **heliotrope** rash (violaceous periorbital erythema with edema), shawl sign across shoulders, and V-neck sign on the chest. Biopsy shows **perifascicular atrophy** (wasted fibers at fascicle edges). Violaceous knuckle papules with weakness indicate dermatomyositis without waiting for biopsy.

steps.say: Polymyositis lacks rashes with CD8 cells invading healthy fibers. Onset is subacute over weeks in adults. Endomysial infiltrates with perforin define the biopsy. Pure motor weakness without rash or CK spikes needs the biopsy.
steps.tx: **Polymyositis** (muscle inflammation without rash) presents in adults with subacute proximal limb-girdle weakness and no cutaneous signs. Biopsy shows endomysial invasion of non-necrotic fibers by clonally expanded **CD8** cytotoxic T cells expressing **perforin** (a pore forming killer protein). Subacute pure motor weakness with endomysial CD8 invasion indicates polymyositis after mimics are excluded.

steps.say: Necrotising myopathy gives massive CK above 10000 to 20000 with scant inflammation on biopsy. Anti-SRP and anti-HMGCR with statin exposure are the definers of it. IVIG joins steroids early. Weakness this severe with pale biopsy is IMNM.
steps.tx: Muscle melting away over days with five-figure CK is **IMNM** (immune-mediated necrotising myopathy, antibody driven fiber death): brutal proximal weakness, CK past **10,000 toward 20,000** units per liter, and fibers dying quietly without inflammatory crowds. Anti-**SRP** and anti-**HMGCR** (the statin linked pair) sign the diagnosis. Pale necrotic biopsy with sky-high CK indicates IMNM, and IVIG opens alongside steroids.

vis.alt: Proximal weakness with sarcolemmal complement deposition, necrotic fibres, and macrophage cleanup.
vis.caption: Complement coated dead fibers with macrophage cleanup mark necrotising disease. Statin history with anti-HMGCR seals it. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Inclusion body myositis is the picker of finger flexors and quadriceps asymmetrically past 50. Rimmed vacuoles with TDP-43 define the biopsy. Immunosuppression does not help. Falls from buckling knees with weak grip in an older man is IBM.
steps.tx: Inclusion body myositis (**IBM**, degenerative muscle disease) affects men above **50 years** with asymmetric deep **finger flexor** (forearm grip) and quadriceps weakness. Biopsy shows basophilic **rimmed vacuoles** (rimmed holes in fibers) with amyloid deposits and **TDP-43** inclusions, running an indolent course refractory to immunosuppression. Asymmetric grip and knee buckling past 50 indicate IBM, and steroids are withheld.

steps.say: Antisynthetase syndrome joins muscle, lung, Raynaud, joints, and cracked hands together. Anti-Jo-1 with PL-7 and PL-12 are the definers of it. Lung disease often dominates the course. Cracked fingertips with breathlessness require the synthetase panel.
steps.tx: When cracked fingertips meet breathlessness, think **antisynthetase syndrome** (tRNA synthetase autoimmunity): muscle inflammation plus lung scarring, Raynaud attacks, gentle non-erosive joint swelling, and **mechanic's hands** (rough fissured fingertips), signed by anti-**Jo-1**, anti-PL-7, or anti-PL-12. Lungs usually outrun muscles in severity. Hands plus lungs indicate the synthetase panel, never antibiotics alone.

vis.alt: Cracked hyperkeratotic fingertips of mechanic's hands in antisynthetase syndrome.
vis.caption: Cracked fingertips with lung disease mark antisynthetase syndrome. The same antibody panel covers Jo-1, PL-7, and PL-12. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Adult dermatomyositis is the carrier of 3 to 6-fold cancer risk with TIF1-gamma and NXP2 marking half the paraneoplastic cases. Age-appropriate screening is mandatory at diagnosis. Dysphagia with nasal speech is the urgency marker. Weakness with a new rash is staged for cancer first.
steps.tx: A new dermatomyositis rash in adulthood multiplies hidden cancer odds **3 to 6-fold**. Anti-**TIF1-gamma** and anti-**NXP2** flag the paraneoplastic half, up to **50 percent** of adult cases, so full age-appropriate tumour hunting starts at diagnosis. **Dysphagia** (failed swallowing) with nasal speech and aspiration marks urgency, and IVIG rescues the swallow before limb power. Rash plus weakness is worked up for cancer first.

steps.say: Induction is high-dose steroids with methotrexate, azathioprine, or mycophenolate alongside. Prednisone 1 mg per kg daily or methylprednisolone pulses are the openers of therapy. IVIG 2 g per kg monthly is the rescue for refractory and necrotising disease. Exercise within tolerance is the preserver of muscle throughout.
steps.tx: Open with heavy glucocorticoids, daily **prednisone 1 mg** per kg or IV **methylprednisolone** pulses, then anchor a steroid sparer, **methotrexate**, azathioprine, or **mycophenolate**, for the long haul. Monthly **IVIG 2 g** per kg salvages refractory cases and IMNM. Physiotherapy grades upward from day one, because still beds waste muscle while movement banks 6-month strength.
